anchor.title: On-Chain Evidence Anchoring
anchor.description: Anchor the SHA-256 hash of the DO-178C verification evidence package to {chain}, providing tamper-proof timestamps and auditable provenance for airworthiness evidence. Hashing costs no Gas; anchoring requires a wallet signature.
anchor.walletDesc: Uses the same wallet connection as the hackathon; the contract records the submitter address and block timestamp.
anchor.verifiedOk: Evidence hash found on-chain, verification passed
anchor.computeHashBackendDesc: Computed by the SkyForge engine backend (canonical SHA-256)
anchor.computeHashLocalDesc: Backend unavailable; computed locally with WebCrypto
anchor.installWalletDesc: Please install a browser wallet extension such as MetaMask
anchor.computeHashFirst: Please compute the anchor hash first
anchor.deployContractDesc: Deploy the EvidenceAnchor contract by running scripts/deploy_anchor.mjs first
anchor.anchorSuccessDesc: The on-chain timestamp and submitter are permanently recorded
